	<div class="b b--rich-text">

		<div class="richtext">
	<p>Council and committee meeting agendas and minutes are legal records of decisions and directions made. </p>
<p>Committees of Council include <a href="https://www.barossa.sa.gov.au/council/committees-and-panels">internal and subsidiary committees</a> and are intended to streamline Council business along with making recommendations to Council. As a member of the public you are welcome to attend and observe these meetings. </p>
<p>Our <a href="https://www.barossa.sa.gov.au/assets/downloads/code-of-conduct/Code-of-Practice-for-Public-Access-Meetings-and-Meeting-Documents.pdf">Code of Practice for Access to Council and Committee Meetings and Associated Documents</a> provides more information on meeting observation. It also provides information on the document types you have access to without requiring an application under the <em><a href="https://www.legislation.gov.au/Details/C2020C00246" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer noopener">Freedom of Information Act</a></em>. </p>
<p>Documents for meetings over at least the last 3 years will remain online. Documents older than and not available online can be accessed in-person at the Nuriootpa office. </p>
</div>
